title: Independent verification: PR540 literal binding and full symbolic checkpoints (no new kappa)
body:
PR540's finite Lean invocation depends on externally extracted literals; its reported independent tests are not shipped as a standalone checker. This adds a code-disjoint, standard-library audit of the pinned PR442 invocation, with no new κ claim.

The sparse GF(2) replay checks every dirty-input column across all 19,002 instructions and all 97 scalar/frame states: 99,328 scalar rows and 99,328 frame labels. It independently decodes the 987-role relocated owner map, all sixteen coordinate permutations and their inverses, and the full inverse-owner logical/padded domains. No discrepancy was found within this scope. One complete positive fixture and 30 semantic/parser/source-pin rejection controls pass, including a helper-restoration fault invisible to target rows.

Base: `dd6403f774a0891093a006ae9716c02e371b1fdb`. Audited PR540: `acc1917034d10f464271ab115fda314fd4eee7a3`. PR442 source: `4e16d001d505d4f21dd2bcfc44591f9be4c279bd`. The package retains 53 immutable source files with Git-blob/SHA256 pins and original notices. OS-random assignment seed **76**, independent-verification track; task card and overlap evidence are included.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr540-literal-source-audit
```

Expected: `PASS_PR540_LITERAL_SOURCE_AUDIT`, 31 passing tests, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The Python 3.12.14 registered replay passes with assertions disabled and matches Python 3.14.5's receipt. The 20 repository onboarding/package tests and metadata/source-pin checks pass. Exact commands and local environments are recorded in `VALIDATION.json`.

This corroborates PR540's earlier reported checks with a reproducible full symbolic implementation. PR1228 and PR1231 address pending-range derivation separately; the supplied bases 15 and 1 remain inherited here. This does not run Lean, check the original-bank charts or rational/native geometry, establish costs/all-size/analytic transfer, or change the selected frontier. Open next questions and these boundaries are explicit in the README/TASK.

Credit cheesegrader's PR540, Douglas Colkitt's PR1228/1231 follow-ups with Claude assistance, and the PR442/PR434 construction lineage including Dylan Crow, Jacob Sussman, Zhihao Chen and the preserved original notices. Prepared by Sricharan Vagvala (@theon199) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0; no independent human mathematical review claimed.
